data.body: Plan readiness correction before the one necessary review: the immutable audit SHA now supplies inventory and before citations only. All other comment tokens and 26 directive attachments remain exact. The local full-suite command was replaced with focused tests, lint, and typecheck. Gerrit Verified CI supplies repository-wide coverage. The corrected oracle was executed successfully before this ticket update.
